(()=>{const out={};for(const tr of [14,15]){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[],rally:true,circuit:true});const c=RACE.cars[0];c.forceAI=1;c.ai={skill:1,lat:0,name:'T'};const T=RACE.T,N=T.N;const Y=[],PX=[],CY=[],I=[],G=[];for(let i=0;i<60*110;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count')RACE.state='race';if(RACE.state!=='race')continue;if((c.lapT||[]).length>=1)break;const g=c.m.g;Y.push(g.position.y);PX.push(g.rotation.x);CY.push(c.camY||0);I.push(c.idx);G.push(c.m.wheels.filter(w=>w.g).length)}const k0=I.findIndex(v=>v*T.sp>1150);out[tr]={px:PX.slice(k0,k0+90).map(v=>+(v*1000).toFixed(0)).join(' '),y:Y.slice(k0,k0+90).map((v,k)=>+((v-(Y[k0+k-1]||v))*1000).toFixed(0)).join(' '),cy:CY.slice(k0,k0+90).map((v,k)=>+((v-(CY[k0+k-1]||v))*1000).toFixed(0)).join(' ')};PT8.cleanupRace()}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
